chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Ribʿī ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sulaymān al-ʿĀmirī, who said:

I said to Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام: What do you say about a man whom I heard reviling ʿAlī and dissociating himself from him? So he said to me: “By Allah, his blood is lawful, and a thousand men from them are not equal to one man from you. Leave him.”

key_terms.أَلْفُ رَجُلٍ: a thousand men, used here for emphatic comparison
key_terms.حَلَالُ الدَّمِ: one whose killing is deemed lawful in the wording of the report
key_terms.رَجُلٍ مِنْكُمْ: one man from among you, indicating the superiority stated in the report
key_terms.عَلِيّاً: Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, the subject of the insult in the report

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام say about someone who reviles Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام and disavows him?
ai.summary: This hadith records a question posed to Imam Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام regarding a man who reviled Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام and disavowed him. The Imam عليه السلام responds with a severe ruling and affirms the immense distinction between the followers of truth and such opponents.
